Theme

Fresha, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the Panda CSS scales every Fresha surface shares (--made-with-panda), the semantic colors.* palette mapped back from the hashed vars through the atomic classes, the partner portal's readable --color-*/--typography-* layer, and the geometry measured on the signed-out pages. The theme buttons set data-theme on <html> the way the partner app does: dark is genuinely painted on the partners.fresha.com sign-in under prefers-color-scheme: dark; accent is a declared scope nothing signed out was observed painting. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Captured signed out on 2026-11-15 at 1440 x 900 (mobile at 390 x 844). Roobert, AktivGroteskVF and the Tartuffo display face are Fresha's own fonts and are not loaded here; the guide uses the system sans and serif.

Colour

The mapped colors.* palette as the current theme resolves it, then the hashed vars no atomic class names (they are real theme values whose Panda names were not recoverable).

Hashed vars (unmapped)

The partner named layer

The readable --color-* vocabulary the partner sheets declare per data-theme — the same paint, spelled out. light.partner.* equals colors.* semantically; the dark and accent rows carry the scope's own values.

Typography

The four --font-* roles Fresha declares, then the partner layer's named type scale (--typography-*: display, header, title, text, utility and label sizes with their letter-spacings).

Space, size and shape

The theme-invariant scales from the Panda token layer: spacing and sizes in px, border widths, aspect ratios and backdrop blurs.

Radii seen on the pages

Fresha's radius values live in the measured components (999px pills, 16px and 8px cards, 12px fields) rather than a named token family — these boxes draw them literally.

Elevation

The Panda shadows.* tokens; level1 and level2 take the current theme's ring colour.

Motion

The durations.* and easings.* token scales, then every duration and easing the probe read on real elements (raw/motion.json). Click a track to play it. prefers-reduced-motion is only partially honoured: home, venue and LP reduce some motion; pricing, for-business, help, auth and the partner sign-in ignore it.

Measured geometry

Component dimensions measured on the live pages (core.component.*, from raw/components-computed.json).

Specimen

A header, the search row, a primary button, chips and a venue card rebuilt from the tokens above — a drawing, not a capture. The real components are in components.md.
